agentSummary: Adds hardware H.264/H.265 video to playtest recordings: playtest_record_start writes an MP4 next to the still track when the GPU encoder is available.
enablesAgentTo: Record a PIE session to a playable MP4 through NVENC, AMF or VideoToolbox
Keep the timestamped still track and marks aligned with the video timeline
Hand a real video file to reviewers instead of a folder of screenshots
whenToEnable: You want playtest recordings as video. Also enable the engine codec plugin for your GPU: NVCodecs (NVIDIA), AMFCodecs (AMD) or VTCodecs (Apple).
